about: The video chat's prompt reference (phase V14, js/merge-v3/vhelp.js). A section with a file is ready; one without is in development and says what it will hold. A section is added by its file and its line here.

sections.label: Camera movement
sections.about: How the camera moves through the shot - 46 moves, each with a looping example.

sections.label: Light
sections.about: Time of day, hard and soft light, backlight and rim light, neon, candlelight, practical lamps - and how to ask for them.

sections.label: Shot size & angle
sections.about: From an extreme close-up to an establishing shot; eye level, low and high angle, top-down, Dutch tilt, point of view.

sections.label: Lens & focus
sections.about: Wide, normal and portrait lenses, macro, telephoto compression, shallow depth of field, rack focus.

sections.label: Style & film look
sections.about: Film grain, 16 mm, VHS, glossy commercial, documentary, the phone-shot UGC look, colour grades.

sections.label: Speed & time
sections.about: Slow motion, speed ramps, time-lapse, hyperlapse, freeze frames, reverse.

sections.label: Acting & movement
sections.about: How the person moves and plays: gestures, gaze, pace, emotion, talking to the camera.

sections.label: Sound & speech
sections.about: Spoken lines in their own language, voice, ambience, room tone, music - for the models that make sound.

sections.label: Transitions between shots
sections.about: Shot 1, Shot 2, match cuts, whip transitions, cutting on action - for a clip of several shots.

sections.label: UGC techniques
sections.about: A selfie at arm's length, a phone's handheld shake, the mirror shot, unboxing, the product held to the camera, a testimonial.
